text.description_html:
Omnia 4036, Contemporary Mortise Lockset

The Contemporary Lever Mortise Lockset for residential and commercial use. Built to withstand heavy use, the commercial grade, UL listed, and fire rated mortise lock combines precision engineering for security and durability with attractive design. The backplates feature a unique inside-to-outside mounting with screw-less outside plates. This tough mortise set has a 1 inch armored front.

Each set contains door levers, backplates, mortise latchset, spindle, and all necessary screws and templates. Key functions are supplied with lock cylinder/s and turnpiece as applicable.

Single Cylinder Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button; then opens by key outside, by lever inside. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside.

Specifications for the Omnia 4036 Contemporary Mortise Set:

  • Backplate Height 8-1/4"
  • Doors Thickness: Optional, 1-3/4" - 2-1/4" Thick Doors (Contact us if doors are thicker)
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • 1” Armored Front
  • Solid Brass Levers and Trim
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy wrought steel with zinc dichromate finish for corrosion resistance.
  • Front: Adjustable armored steel front, with 8" x 1-1/4" solid brass faceplate for all lock bodies, finished to match trim.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • Lock Cylinder: Standard "C" keyway supplied with two nickel silver keys.
  • Omnia Mortise Lockset Dimensions & Specs (PDF)

Sold Individually. Custom item, NOT Returnable.
